what: APP= parameter on the scripts, a second served directory on the same API process, and a ROUTES filter for verify-pages. Default behaviour unchanged; no app yet.
must_not_touch: apps/api/src/** except the five files named
scripts/verify.sh and scripts/test/deploy-logic.sh (they name no app dir; edit one assertion only if a test fails, say so)
contract: ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.2. Verified in tree: index.ts passes env.DASHBOARD_DIR to createDashboardHandler, env.ts defines it, the plist sets it to __RELEASE_DIR__/apps/dashboard/dist. Decision (reversible default): a new optional env DASHBOARD_V3_DIR (default empty) parsed in env.ts and passed as option `v3Dir`; the plist adds DASHBOARD_V3_DIR=__RELEASE_DIR__/apps/dashboard-v3/dist; DASHBOARD_DIR is untouched. Same origin and auth, no new hostname. v3-argo-cutover-flip removes both.
exemplar: scripts/verify-pages.ts already takes BASE: mirror that env style for APP and ROUTES.
change: 1. APP= (default dashboard) on deploy.sh build_dashboard (build command, dist check, DRY_RUN plan line; builds both apps when apps/dashboard-v3 exists), dev.sh, design-shot index and models-fixture (resolves apps/$APP/src/features/models/__fixtures__/efficiency, fails loudly if missing), evidence index. 2. serve-dashboard: with v3Dir set, /v3/* serves it (SPA fallback to its index.html, /v3/assets/* immutable, traversal refused, /api and the OTLP relay not shadowed); unset means /v3/ is 404. 3. verify-pages: ROUTES (space or comma separated) replaces the routes.txt list when set; finance paths are passed by hand (not in routes.txt: the vault is locked). Rule: none. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: `make deploy DRY_RUN=1` plan; `bun test apps/api/src`; after the factory deploy `make version` equals origin/master and `make verify` exits 0.
acceptance: serve-dashboard.test.ts covers: /v3/ serves the v3 dir index with SPA fallback, /v3/assets/* is immutable-cached, a traversal path under /v3/ is refused, /api/* is not shadowed, and with v3Dir unset /v3/ answers 404

`rg -n 'apps/dashboard/' scripts/design-shot scripts/evidence scripts/deploy.sh scripts/dev.sh` finds only the APP default
`make deploy DRY_RUN=1` still plans the apps/dashboard build and its output differs from before only by the APP variable
`make verify-pages ROUTES=/models` loads exactly one route and prints it; with ROUTES unset it loads every routes.txt line
`make check` exits 0; after the factory deploy `make version` equals origin/master and `make verify` exits 0 (state not-run until deployed)
